agentSummary: Adds tools for the legacy Composure compositing plugin: compositing element actors, parent/child layer trees, input/transform/output passes, render resolution, opacity and target cameras.
enablesAgentTo: List, create, rename, nest and delete compositing elements
Author input, transform and output passes on an element with validated properties
Set element render resolution, opacity and target camera
Request a compositing render or a named render target for verification
whenToEnable: Your project uses the (legacy) Composure plugin for real-time compositing shots.
